definition.en: The flat triangular bone at the back of the shoulder; it moves on the rib cage and carries the shoulder socket.
definition.zh: 肩后方的扁平三角骨，在胸廓上活动，外侧有肩关节的关节盂。

definition.en: The usually more fixed attachment of a muscle; the moving end can change when an exercise fixes the limb.
definition.zh: 肌肉通常较固定的附着端；肢体固定时，活动端可以改变。

definition.en: The usually more mobile attachment of a muscle; force acts between this attachment and the origin.
definition.zh: 肌肉通常较容易移动的附着端；肌肉在它与起点之间产生拉力。

definition.en: The connective-tissue sheets of the thoracic and lumbar back that surround muscles and provide attachments.
definition.zh: 胸背与腰背的结缔组织膜，包围肌肉并提供附着。

definition.en: Strong connective tissue that transmits muscle force to an attachment, commonly a bone.
definition.zh: 把肌肉力量传到附着处的强韧结缔组织，通常连接骨骼。

definition.en: Movement of the shoulder blade towards the spine.
definition.zh: 肩胛骨向脊柱靠近的移动。

definition.en: Supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis, whose tendons surround and help steady the shoulder joint.
definition.zh: 冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌、肩胛下肌及其肌腱，围绕并帮助稳定肩关节。

definition.en: Turning a limb outward around its long axis; at the shoulder this turns the humerus, not just the forearm.
definition.zh: 肢体沿长轴向外转；肩关节外旋转动的是肱骨，不只是前臂。

definition.en: Rotation of the shoulder blade that turns its socket upward as the arm rises.
definition.zh: 肩胛骨回旋使关节盂朝上，配合手臂抬高。

definition.en: A joint movement that generally increases its angle; at the shoulder it moves the arm backwards, and at the spine it bends the trunk back.
definition.zh: 通常增大关节角的动作；肩关节伸展让手臂向后，脊柱伸展让躯干向后。

definition.en: A controlled spinal position retaining the usual curves, rather than forcing maximal rounding or arching.
definition.zh: 保留通常曲线的受控脊柱位置，不刻意做到最大弓背或挺腰。

definition.en: Generating muscle force while muscle length and the related joint position remain approximately steady.
definition.zh: 肌肉产生力量，长度与相关关节位置大致保持不变。

definition.en: Recording a muscle’s electrical activity; exercise comparisons do not by themselves predict muscle growth.
definition.zh: 记录肌肉电活动；动作间的肌电比较本身不能预测增肌效果。

definition.en: The part of a movement during which an active muscle lengthens under load.
definition.zh: 正在用力的肌肉在负荷下被拉长的动作阶段。
